# Field Guide

## Stable IDs

Use project-local IDs:

- Scene: `scn-001`
- Unit: `unt-001`
- Beat: `bea-001`

Never renumber an existing ID during a retry. New items receive new IDs.

## Source references

Prefer line ranges when the input preserves lines. Otherwise use paragraph or character offsets. A source reference identifies evidence; it is not a summary.

## Production facts

Classify facts as:

- `explicit`: directly present in source text.
- `inferred`: conservative interpretation required for structure.
- `unknown`: required downstream but unavailable.

Attach confidence and source references to inferred facts.
